title: Bar Ahina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bar Ahina. Kiddushin 9b, 51b; Sotah 39b: "Rava said: Bar Ahina explained it to me." Hyman also gives his name as Rava. Menachot 37b: "Rav Yosef said, etc."; "Rava bar Ahina said, etc." — or perhaps, Hyman suggests, the text should read: "Rava said," "Bar Ahina said."

notes.text: The consulted Menachot 37b reads Rava bar Ahina together. The proposed division into two speakers is Hyman’s conjecture.
